title: Elodie and the Inventory
author: Casper Sterling
blurb: Wren Iversen, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
